items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 12 September 2026 8:56am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 12 September 2026 at 8:45am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds at first.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure northwest of Ireland, frontal


##Wind##

Southwest 6 or 7, although a force or two lighter in Liverpool Bay, then gradually decreasing West or Southwest 5 or 6 in all waters later this morning, and further decreasing 4 or 5 this afternoon. Veering West or Northwest 3 or 4 this evening, then becoming Variable or Southeast 2 or 3 tonight.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, becoming mainly moderate this afternoon, then slight in the evening.


##Weather##

Rain and drizzle at first soon clearing to isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in precipitation at first.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Variable or Southeast 2 or 3, settling South or Southwest 3 or 4 later.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Fair, then mist and fog patches later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling or very poor in mist and fog patches later.
